verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own integration docs say it maps users with access and checks whether they have offboarded the organization, which is a first-party offboarding-access check. Nothing in the evidence shows HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklists or proof that new hires completed training. Missing for 10: HR-system sync driving the joiner/leaver lifecycle, onboarding checklists, training-completion tracking for new hires, documented access-revocation evidence for leavers, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access

citations.quote: It helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.
